entries.what: xAI retired grok-4-1-fast-reasoning on 2026-05-15. Requests do not fail: the slug still resolves and is served by grok-4.3 with low reasoning effort, billed at that model's rates ($1.25 per 1M input and $2.50 per 1M output).

source.quote: requests to the retired model slugs above will automatically redirect to grok-4.3. The slugs themselves continue to resolve, so you do not need to change your code to avoid breakage.

lookFor: The model ID grok-4-1-fast-reasoning sent to xAI (api.x.ai, its SDK, or a client pointed at it), or xai/grok-4-1-fast-reasoning. Not a gateway's vendor/name form such as x-ai/grok-4-1-fast-reasoning, and not an Azure Foundry deployment.
entries.replacement: grok-4.3, which is what the redirect serves at low reasoning effort.
requires: Set reasoning_effort on the request to choose it: none, low, medium or high. The redirect picks for you, and the price changes with the model.

entries.what: xAI retired grok-imagine-image-pro on 2026-05-15, with a redirect to grok-imagine-image-quality, which was itself retired on 2026-11-02. Requests do not fail: they are now served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 at quality low, at that model's lower price.

source.quote: Requests to grok-imagine-image-pro, which already redirect to grok-imagine-image-quality, follow it to grok-imagine-image-2.0 at low.

lookFor: The model ID grok-imagine-image-pro sent to xAI (api.x.ai, its SDK, or a client pointed at it), or xai/grok-imagine-image-pro. Not a gateway's vendor/name form such as x-ai/grok-imagine-image-pro, and not an Azure Foundry deployment.
requires: The redirect pins quality to low. grok-imagine-image-2.0 takes quality low, medium or auto, and auto is its default when quality is left out, so set it to keep what you pay for.
